name: dtd
description: The Describable Textures Dataset (DTD) is a collection of texture images labeled with human-interpretable attributes used to evaluate texture recognition and classification. It measures a model's ability to recognize and discriminate between a broad set of texture categories under varying imaging conditions. DTD is commonly used to benchmark image feature representations and transfer learning in computer vision.
reputation: Widely used and well-regarded in the computer vision community as a standard benchmark for texture recognition and representation learning.
